description: List Notion database views. Pass exactly one of database_id or data_source_id. Returns a curated summary of each view (id, name, type, url, data_source_id) plus pagination cursors; set include_config: true for the full raw Notion view objects.

include_config.description: Return the full raw Notion view objects (filter, sorts, configuration, parent) instead of the curated summary. Default false.

page_size.description: Maximum number of views to return

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: list_views
